mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following a UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tighter monetary policy, which is expected to lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of the 20-day windows following a FEDFUNDS increase above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is strong and unemployment (UNRATE) is low, it signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the 60-day windows when GDPC1 growth is strong and UNRATE is low.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased supply, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days if demand does not keep pace.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following an INDPRO increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following a HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of the 20-day windows following a PAYEMS increase.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is strong but inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high, it signals potential economic instability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows when GDPC1 growth is strong and CPIAUCSL growth is high.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of the 20-day windows following an RSAFS increase.
